referencePolicy: Repository reference images informed only broad art direction and character identity. No reference image is shipped or used at runtime.
commonPrompt: Create one original, child-friendly 2D storybook cutout wearable for Essma World. Warm Sonoran palette, tactile woven or embroidered materials, simple readable silhouette, front-facing layer aligned to the supplied production character base. Isolated on a solid chroma-key background. No person, face, hands, logos, branding, letters, ratings, copied pose, or imitation of a named studio.
postProcess: Chroma-key removal, transparent-edge inspection, crop and placement on the character runtime canvas, then derived 256px thumbnail.
